api.delta_sign: V_post_update - V_rollout on identical frozen observations
api.fit_scope: in-sample on frozen self-bootstrapped GAE targets; no pass threshold or causal interpretation
api.statistics: Population variance/covariance (ddof0), detached CPU float64 after transfer from accelerator. EV null at target variance <=1e-12. Existing legacy EV calculation stays float32/original dtype unchanged.
api.units: learner_scaled_returns; reward scale remains in PPOConfig (0.1 default)

behavior_preservation: Learner loss, GAE, optimizer steps, hyperparameters and existing metrics untouched.
Feature/target/rollout tensors not mutated; gradients disabled during post-update forward.
Post predictions use bounded chunks of config.minibatch_size. Guard called before and after every chunk.
Per-module mode flags, registered buffers, CPU/MPS/CUDA Torch RNG restored even on prediction/guard failure.
Progress remains in_update/incomplete if diagnostics fail after actual optimizer steps; no false completed-update publication.
limitations: No real native environment, full teacher training, checkpoint decoding or rollout experiment executed.
MPS test covers diagnostic inference and RNG restoration, not exact end-to-end MPS Adam parity.
Extra no-grad forward and CPU moment passes consume runtime and are subject to parent campaign limits.
No statement about held-out critic accuracy or whether longer training improves survival.
other_writes: Only owned evidence directory; no state/docs/installed binary edits.
scope: Optional direct same-batch critic instrumentation; no gameplay, checkpoint decoding or training campaign.

tests.CPU_parity: Two consecutive updates with fresh frozen synthetic buffers, checking exact model weights, Adam including nonempty second-step state, Torch RNG, all legacy metrics and immutable batch data.
oracles: Independent scalar target/prediction/error moments and covariance.
Constant residual bias: EV1 while residual mean/MSE detect error.
Degenerate targets -> nullEV and finite JSON; malformed/nonfinite/overflow values rejected.
Chunk order and no-grad forwards; model modes/buffers/gradients/RNG restoration on success and guard/nonfinite failure.
MPS inference transfers predictions to CPU before double conversion and restores accelerator RNG.

runs.reason_for_second_run: Parent requested two-consecutive-update Adam/RNG parity and optional covariance/RMS delta V; code/tests extended after first successful run.

runs.reason_for_run: Made CPU-transfer-before-float64 explicit and added MPS RNG-preservation coverage before parent runtime use.
